title: Design System: Cha — The Quiet Leaf

display.purpose: Hero headline only. One italic word per line carries the accent color.

title.purpose: Component-level headings: benefit names, ritual stop names, brew step titles.

body.purpose: Running copy, capped near 46–60ch in practice.

label.purpose: Kickers, nav links, buttons, form notes — heavily tracked uppercase.

shadows.name: blob-frame-float-light
shadows.purpose: Under blob-framed photography on light (paper) sections.

shadows.name: blob-frame-float-dark
shadows.purpose: Under blob-framed photography on dark (pine) sections.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover-only, tinted to match the button's own fill color, paired with translateY(-3px).

shadows.name: cup-float
shadows.purpose: The steep-timer cup illustration, separating it from the page behind it.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default drift easing for reveals, hovers, headline rises.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: Softer easing for nav background crossfade, wave/steam loops.

motion.name: blob-morph-cycle
motion.value: 16s–24s ease-in-out infinite alternate, per-instance delay offset
motion.purpose: Organic border-radius drift on every blob frame; offsets prevent instances syncing.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink Green fill, the default light-section CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.95rem 1.9rem; border-radius: 99px; font: 600 0.8rem/1 Karla, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: oklch(52% 0.145 152); color: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1), background 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(45% 0.122 152); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -12px oklch(52% 0.145 152 / 0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(52% 0.145 152); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); transition-duration: 0.08s; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Steeped Gold fill — the 'big ask' CTA, used on both light and dark sections.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.95rem 1.9rem; border-radius: 99px; font: 600 0.8rem/1 Karla, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: oklch(72% 0.105 73); color: oklch(20% 0.042 168); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1), background 0.3s; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: oklch(78% 0.105 73); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -12px oklch(72% 0.105 73 / 0.4); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(72% 0.105 73); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: translateY(1px); transition-duration: 0.08s; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent secondary action, border and text shift to accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.95rem 1.9rem; border-radius: 99px; font: 600 0.8rem/1 Karla, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: oklch(24% 0.022 55); border: 1.5px solid oklch(24% 0.022 55 / 0.28); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1), border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: oklch(52% 0.145 152); color: oklch(52% 0.145 152); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(52% 0.145 152); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Toggle Pill Group
components.description: Segmented tea selector; selected state driven by aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-toggle-pill { font: 600 0.72rem/1 Karla, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.55rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 99px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: oklch(44% 0.027 58); border: 1.5px solid oklch(24% 0.022 55 / 0.22); transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1); } .ds-toggle-pill:hover { border-color: oklch(52% 0.145 152); color: oklch(52% 0.145 152); } .ds-toggle-pill[aria-pressed="true"] { background: oklch(52% 0.145 152); border-color: oklch(52% 0.145 152); color: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79); } .ds-toggle-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(52% 0.145 152); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1.1rem 1.5rem; background: oklch(20% 0.042 168); } .ds-nav-logo { font: 400 1.35rem/1 Fraunces, serif; color: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2.2rem; } .ds-nav-link { font: 500 0.82rem/1 Karla, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79 / 0.70); text-decoration: none; position: relative; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79); } .ds-nav-cta { padding: 0.6rem 1.3rem; border-radius: 99px; border: 1.5px solid oklch(95.9% 0.008 79 / 0.35); color: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79); font: 500 0.82rem/1 Karla, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1); } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: oklch(72% 0.105 73); border-color: oklch(72% 0.105 73); color: oklch(20% 0.042 168); }

components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.2rem 1fr; gap: 1.2rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 1.3rem 0.8rem; border-top: 1px solid oklch(24% 0.022 55 / 0.14); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(24% 0.022 55 / 0.14); transition: background 0.45s cubic-bezier(.4,.05,.2,1); } .ds-row::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; background: oklch(52% 0.145 152); transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: bottom; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1); } .ds-row:hover { background: oklch(99.5% 0.004 79); } .ds-row:hover::before { transform: scaleY(1); } .ds-row-num { font: 300 1.1rem/1 Fraunces, serif; font-style: italic; color: oklch(24% 0.022 55 / 0.35); transition: color 0.4s; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-num { color: oklch(52% 0.145 152); } .ds-row-name { font: 400 1.4rem/1.15 Fraunces, serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(24% 0.022 55); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; } .ds-row-desc { color: oklch(44% 0.027 58); font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Signup Input Pill
components.description: Compound pill form: input and button share one container; border glows gold on focus-within.
components.css: .ds-input-pill { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; max-width: 460px; background: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79 / 0.07); border: 1px solid oklch(95.9% 0.008 79 / 0.18); padding: 0.45rem; border-radius: 99px; transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-input-pill:focus-within { border-color: oklch(72% 0.105 73); } .ds-input-pill input { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79); font: 400 0.95rem/1 Karla, sans-serif; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-input-pill input::placeholder { color: oklch(95.9% 0.008 79 / 0.4); } .ds-input-pill .ds-btn-gold { padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem; }

components.name: Blob Frame
components.description: Signature photographic treatment: organically morphing border-radius, slow alternating loop, soft diffuse float shadow.
components.css: .ds-blob { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; width: 220px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 46% 54% 52% 48% / 55% 47% 53% 45%; animation: dsBlobMorph 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate; box-shadow: 0 30px 70px -30px oklch(24% 0.022 55 / 0.40); } .ds-blob-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: oklch(52% 0.145 152 / 0.35); } @keyframes dsBlobMorph { 0% { border-radius: 46% 54% 52% 48% / 55% 47% 53% 45%; } 33% { border-radius: 56% 44% 42% 58% / 45% 58% 42% 55%; } 66% { border-radius: 44% 56% 58% 42% / 58% 44% 56% 44%; } 100% { border-radius: 52% 48% 44% 56% / 48% 54% 46% 54%; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-blob { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
This is what an evidence-led wellness brand looks like when it refuses to shout. The canvas is warm paper, never sterile white; the type is a serif set deliberately light (300 weight) so presence comes from scale and optical sizing, not boldness; and the one saturated color in the system — a muted ink green — is spent like ink itself, sparingly, on links and moments that matter. Dark sections don't reach for the same green; they shift the whole palette to a deep pine "band" with gold kickers, so the accent never gets diluted by overuse.

Motion carries as much of the brand voice as color does. Nothing here bounces, snaps, or springs — border-radii drift through slow morphing blob shapes over 16–24 second loops, a fine grain texture animates almost imperceptibly, and every scroll reveal eases up 34px on a quiet exponential curve. The system explicitly rejects the vocabulary of a generic SaaS landing page: no hero-metric tiles, no gradient text, no glassmorphism-as-decoration, no identical icon-card grids. Confidence is expressed by what the system leaves out.
keyCharacteristics: Warm oklch neutrals throughout; never pure #fff or #000.
Fraunces at weight 300 for display type; one italic word per headline carries the accent color.
A single working accent (ink green) plus a dark-mode counterpart (steeped gold) — never both loud at once.
Organic, morphing blob frames as the system's signature photographic treatment.
Motion drifts on slow, exponential ease-out curves; reduced-motion gets a fully equivalent static experience, not a stripped one.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: The accent green is used like ink — sparingly, and only where it signals something (a link, an active state, a CTA). It is never a background fill of any real surface area.

rules.name: The No-Pure Rule
rules.body: No #fff, no #000, anywhere in the system. Every neutral, light or dark, carries the same warm hue lean so paper and ink read as part of one material, not a generic light/dark toggle.

rules.name: The Italic Word Rule
rules.body: Exactly one word per major headline flips to italic in the section's accent color. Reserve it for the word that carries the emotional payload of the line, never for emphasis of convenience.

rules.name: The Floats, Doesn't Sit Rule
rules.body: Shadow is reserved for elements the system wants to read as suspended above the page — photography, the cup, a hovered button — never applied to static cards, containers, or rest-state UI.

dos: Do keep every neutral tinted warm (hue ~55–79); never introduce a pure white or pure black surface.
Do spend the Ink Green / Steeped Gold accents sparingly — on links, active states, and CTAs, never as a large fill.
Do use the italic-word treatment for at most one word per headline, on the word carrying the emotional weight of the line.
Do ease all motion with a slow, exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1) / .4,.05,.2,1) — drift, never bounce or spring.
Do ship a fully equivalent prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every brand-carrying animation (blob morph, grain, canvas particles, scroll reveal) — static, not degraded.
Do reserve shadow for things meant to read as floating (photography, the cup, hover states) — flat everywhere else.
donts: Don't build hero-metric tiles (big number + label + gradient accent) — the PRODUCT.md anti-reference is explicitly "generic SaaS landing page" patterns like this.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) for emphasis; emphasis comes from the italic-word rule or weight/size, never a gradient fill.
Don't reach for glassmorphism as decoration; the one backdrop-filter in the system (scrolled nav) is functional legibility, not a decorative panel.
Don't default to identical icon-heading-text card grids; the benefits section is deliberately an editorial list, not a card grid.
Don't reach for a modal as the first solution; the system has none, and nothing here (signup, tea picker, brew timer) needed one.
Don't write urgency copy (countdowns, "limited time," exclamation-heavy CTAs) — the brand's confidence comes from restraint, not pressure.
